title: Demonic Mirroring Ice Crystals
body:
Syntax: perform demonic mirroring ice crystals <target>

Description: Haku's signature mirror assault strikes one enemy hard and may blind them.  Requires Ice Release and its revealed chakra natures, without a clan bloodline. Base damage: 1509-1789. 35% chance to inflict blinded. Unlocks at level 70. Costs 78 Chakra and 0 Stamina; 24 second cooldown.

Date: 2026-09-27
